definitions.explanation: Hair grown on the upper lip. One of several words for facial hair that Japanese distinguishes by where it grows.

examples.japanese: {口|くち}ひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|は}やす→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立派|りっぱ}→立派：01093_rippa⟧な{口|くち}ひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|は}やしていた→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather had a fine mustache.

examples.japanese: ⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{口|くち}ひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|は}やしていて→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧、⟦{一瞬|いっしゅん}→一瞬：01805_isshun⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧だ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{分|わ}からなかった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: My friend, whom I hadn't seen in a long time, had grown a mustache, and for a moment I didn't recognize him.

notes:
Also written {口髭|くちひげ}. ⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧ takes ⟦{生|は}やす→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧ (to grow) and ⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧ (to shave).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口|くち}ひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{生|は}やす→生やす：02399_hayasu⟧: to grow a mustache
- {口|くち}ひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}る→剃る：00384_soru⟧: to shave off one's mustache
- {口|くち}ひげ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧: to trim one's mustache

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧: facial hair in general
- ⟦あごひげ→あごひげ：20973_agohige⟧ ({顎髭|あごひげ}): beard on the chin
- ほおひげ ({頬髭|ほおひげ}): whiskers on the cheeks
- {無精|ぶしょう}⟦ひげ→ひげ：01332_hige⟧: stubble
